notes.Ajay Mitchell: Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace were both hurt Sunday, and Mitchell had 18 points, six rebounds, four assists and three steals in 28 minutes.
notes.Alex Caruso: He had 12 points, seven rebounds and six assists in 22 minutes Sunday, and OKC is down two guards on the second night of a back-to-back.
notes.Jared McCain: He started the second half Sunday for Cason Wallace but scored three points in 21 minutes.
notes.Jay Huff: Ivica Zubac sprained his ankle Sunday, and Huff started the second half and had 14 points and three blocks in 21 minutes.
notes.Obi Toppin: With Ivica Zubac out, Toppin is the small-ball backup center after 16 points in 20 minutes Sunday.
notes.Tyrese Haliburton: He had 24 points and 10 assists Sunday and is playing the second night of the back-to-back.
notes.Kyrie Irving: He returns on a minutes limit after playing 25 and 24 minutes in his first two games.
notes.Zaccharie Risacher: Naji Marshall is out with an illness, and Risacher has played 32 minutes in each of the last two games.
notes.Khaman Maluach: Oso Ighodaro is doubtful, so Maluach should start at center again.
notes.Dennis Schroder: Coby White is still out, and Schroder played 38 minutes Saturday.
notes.Grayson Allen: Kon Knueppel and Coby White are out, and Allen played 34 minutes off the bench Saturday.
notes.Kyshawn George: AJ Dybantsa is still out, and George had 22 points and nine rebounds in 36 minutes Saturday.
notes.Zach Edey: He sat Sunday and is expected back Monday.
